<thought>Based on the mass spectrum, the monoisotopic mass is 141.115 Da, which matches the exact mass of the formula C₈H₁₅NO (C8 = 96 Da, H15 ≈ 15.117 Da, N ≈ 14.003 Da, O ≈ 15.995 Da). This formula has a double‑bond equivalent of 2, consistent with a carbonyl (amide) plus one C=C double bond. A simple structure satisfying these constraints is an unsaturated primary amide: CCCCCC=CC(=O)N. This SMILES string is valid and corresponds to C₈H₁₅NO. </thought>
<final_answer>CCCCCC=CC(=O)N</final_answer>
